payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a pixel art inspired interface. Use: pixelated fonts, 8-bit or 16-bit aesthetic, sharp edges (image-rendering: pixelated), limited color palette, blocky UI elements, retro gaming feel.
payload.best_for: Indie games, retro tools, creative portfolios, nostalgia marketing, Web3/NFT
payload.css_technical_keywords: font-family: 'Press Start 2P', image-rendering: pixelated, box-shadow: 4px 0 0 #000 (pixel border), no anti-aliasing
payload.do_not_use_for: Professional corporate, modern SaaS, high-res photography sites
payload.effects_and_animation: Frame-by-frame sprite animation, blinking cursor, instant transitions, marquee text
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Pixelated fonts loaded, ☐ Images sharp (no blur), ☐ CSS box-shadow for pixel borders, ☐ Retro palette, ☐ Blocky layout
payload.keywords: Retro, 8-bit, 16-bit, gaming, blocky, nostalgic, pixelated, arcade
payload.primary_colors: Primary colors (NES Palette), brights, limited palette
payload.secondary_colors: Black outlines, shading via dithering or block colors
